message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_visual_patterns_against_generic_tool_outputs", "description": "When automated classifiers or report generators provide generic findings that contradict specific visual distributional patterns, prioritize direct inspection of original image pixels to verify anatomical features.", "applicable_conditions": "Applicable in medical imaging interpretation tasks where automated tools (classifiers, report generators) yield non-specific or conflicting labels that may overlook high-specificity morphological evidence such as anatomical sparing or distinct pattern distributions.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If automated tools (e.g., `chest_xray_classifier`, `chest_xray_report_generator`) return generic or conflicting findings (e.g., 'metastatic disease', high effusion scores) that appear inconsistent with specific visual cues: (1) Do not accept the tool output as final; (2) Directly inspect the original image pixels to verify high-specificity distributional features (e.g., costophrenic angle sparing, nodular distribution); (3) Override the generic tool label if clear morphological evidence supports a more specific differential diagnosis."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
